title: Public participation.
bodyText: Public participation activities may be implemented by the department and required of responsible parties, in accordance with the state contingency plan, or any other state rule.
bodyHtml: [§128D-14]  Public participation.  Public participation activities may be implemented by the department and required of responsible parties, in accordance with the state contingency plan, or any other state rule. [L 1990, c 298, pt of §17]
